# Phase 4 tuning on the validation split

95 validation sequences, 81 settings, track_low_thresh 0.1 and fuse_score True fixed (Ultralytics defaults).

Selection rule (fixed in advance): score = coverage(conf >= 0.5) - share of 1-2 frame tracks - share of pairs with no overlap - share of tracks with a class change. Ties go to the Ultralytics defaults, then to the setting closest to them.

## Recommended setting

```
{"track_high_thresh": 0.25, "new_track_thresh": 0.5, "match_thresh": 0.9, "track_buffer_sec": 0.4}
```

Score 0.598 vs Ultralytics defaults 0.488

Command for every split (frozen setting):

```
python -m src.tracking.run_tracking --track-high-thresh 0.25 --new-track-thresh 0.5 --match-thresh 0.9 --track-buffer-sec 0.4
```
